title: VeriWe
description: Bots and duplicate accounts have created a chaotic environment in the world of reviews. There are so many fake reviews circulating the markets that it has become almost impossible to distinguish a real from a fraudulent one. The most optimum solution would obviously be to have only one review from one person on a particular product.
how_its_made: Being our first hackathon, absolutely everything was a challenge for us. This was the first time we sat down to code for so long at a stretch. Sheer will-power was the only thing that helped us get through everything.
